title: ClanMember
description: A clan member data structure for Discord bot.

source.description: The source of the clan data, either from Discord or web.

clanid.description: The unique ID of the clan.

membersource.description: The source of the member data, either from Discord or web.

memberid.description: The unique ID of the user.

role.description: The role of the user in the clan.

mention.description: The mention name for the user.

taskkill.description: The number of task kills performed.

attacktime.description: Attack management flags (0: not attacked, number: overtime seconds).

sortie.description: Attack in progress flag (0: not attacking, other: sortie number).

damage.description: The damage dealt to the boss.

attackmessage.description: The attack declaration message (Discord Message object).

lastactive.description: The timestamp of the last activity.
